kind: final native UI patch visual review aggregate

runs.scope: Exact application build and all regression suites
Same frozen archives; repeated 19 patch checks per path with passive visible resize frames

coverage.method: Delegated individual lossless original-resolution review, with recorded SHA-256 equality covering identical copies; 178 capture files does not mean 178 unique images or views.

receipts.scope: reference management and scroll both paths

passiveResizeObservations.captureMethod: Visible desktop BitBlt before PrintWindow, with no keyboard/pointer input or forced redraw between samples.
passiveResizeObservations.ordinary: Four immediate frames retain earlier geometry. All 12 later passive frames show complete controls; each series is byte-identical from its first settled sample (about 301–334 ms) through its final sample (about 1368–1400 ms).
passiveResizeObservations.spaces: Fresh tool immediate frame retains earlier geometry and settles by the first nominal 250-ms sample. Fresh workflow and both upgraded series are already settled and byte-identical across their four samples.
passiveResizeObservations.timingScope: Filename delays are nominal. Actual elapsed times are recorded in the native reports; no universal repaint deadline or between-frame behavior is inferred.

reviewCorrection.originalConcern: Initial full-frame reviews described General settings and Readiness as missing.
reviewCorrection.resolution: Exact crops from the original hashed BMPs show both controls. This was an interpretation error, not an established application defect or capture-timing omission. Corrected original and attempt-2 receipts retain the retraction.

limits: Hosted Windows Server 2022 at 96 DPI; actual patch workspace sizes 960x680 and 1024x728. Requested 1280x900 was capped to the actual monitor work area.
Immediate resize frames can retain prior geometry. Finite samples do not establish zero flicker or exclude shorter unsampled transients.
PrintWindow requests paint; those frames are distinguished from passive visible-screen frames.
Legacy scroll and results fixtures deliberately request other window dimensions; their screenshots do not establish startup work-area containment.
Representative PCs, smaller work areas, high DPI and transitions, multiple monitors, physical trackpads and managed-machine acceptance remain outstanding.
Visual layout/readability review does not add scientific acceptance beyond the separately recorded native assertions.
rawEvidence: Original BMPs remain in the hashed Actions artifacts referenced by the native validation record; binaries and screenshots are not committed.
publicationStatus: unpublished draft review candidate; no merge or release
